label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee gathering celebrating my forty years as mayor, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, under cover of a lighting inspection with the builder's escort. Freight is coordinating lanterns and 200 fresh loaves; the baker has delivered 32 and still needs ingredients for 168. Freight was seeking the builder and innkeeper to coordinate, though their precise jubilee roles are not directly confirmed. The secretary knowingly relays and checks arrangements and funding. The surprise has already been disclosed to me; bread freshness, financing and timely completion remain uncertain.
